redfin.remarks: Welcome to 5239 Avenida Hacienda, a gated contemporary estate situated on an expansive, flat lot in one of Tarzana’s most desirable pockets south of Ventura Boulevard. Designed for luxury living and entertaining, this exceptional property seamlessly blends sophisticated interiors with resort-style indoor-outdoor living. The main residence features 6 bedrooms and 7 bathrooms, highlighted by a dramatic open-concept floor plan, designer finishes, and walls of Fleetwood doors that open the home to the backyard. The chef’s kitchen is built for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring a large center island, Sub-Zero refrigerator, custom finishes, and walk-in pantry. Additional amenities include a home theater , private office , Control4 smart-home system, multiple fireplaces, and spacious living and entertaining areas throughout. The oversized primary suite is a true retreat, complete with a fireplace, dual walk-in closets, a resort-inspired bathroom, and an impressive private balcony overlooking the grounds. Discover your own private resort outdoors. The flat backyard features a stunning infinity-edge pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, basketball court, expansive lawn and multiple areas for lounging, dining and entertaining. Adding incredible versatility is a detached, two-level ADU/guest house spanning over 1,100 square feet. It features an upstairs bedroom, downstairs loft, one full bathroom and two half bathrooms, providing an ideal setup for guests, extended family, a private office, gym or additional entertainment space. Above it all, a rooftop entertaining area with bar creates another incredible setting to relax and entertain. Private, gated and designed to take full advantage of Southern California living, 5239 Avenida Hacienda offers the space, amenities and flexibility of a true luxury compound — all just moments from Ventura Boulevard with convenient access to shopping, dining and major freeways.
